title: Nine-panel storyboard grid as one reference
technique: reference image: a 3x3 storyboard sheet guides a multi-shot clip

keyframes.prompt: A storyboard sheet: a 3 by 3 grid of nine equal cinematic panels, thin white gutters, no text or numbers. A lone lighthouse keeper on a stormy island. Panels in reading order: 1 wide shot of the lighthouse in a storm; 2 the keeper climbing the spiral stairs with a lantern; 3 close-up of his weathered hands on the lamp; 4 the beam sweeping over black waves; 5 a small fishing boat tossed by waves; 6 the keeper spotting it through a telescope; 7 him pulling a signal lever; 8 the boat turning toward the beam; 9 dawn, calm sea, the boat moored below the lighthouse. Consistent character, moody teal and amber palette. 16:9 composition.

shots.video_prompt: Follow the nine panels of @Image 1 in order as nine quick shots with hard cuts, keeping the keeper, the lighthouse and the teal and amber palette consistent. Storm wind and crashing waves, a low string drone that resolves into calm at the dawn shot.
